title: Acknowledgements
text: ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS I ’d like to thank the following folks for their role in not only getting this novel into your hands, but for their continued support in nearly everything writerly that I do: Daniel Carpenter, Dan Coxon, Julia Lloyd, Richard Mason, Matt Snow, Cameron McClure, Katie Shea Boutillier, Rebecca Rowland, Philip Fracassi, Brian Keene, Clay McLeod Chapman, Kevin Kangas, Frank Spinney, Katharine Carroll, Bahar Kutluk, Isabelle Sinnott, Melody Wukitch of Park Books, my friends, and of course my family. This story takes place in Los Angeles, and while I don’t live there, fellow author Philip Fracassi does. He not only provided answers to my questions about L.A. throughout the writing of this novel, but supplied me with photographs, detailed maps, and more than just a handful of colorful anecdotes, some of which made it into the story itself. In an industry as cutthroat as publishing, Philip is one of the good guys. Go read his books. Ronald Malfi Annapolis, Maryland October 17, 2024
